identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Simplify startup to one config, one binary, and one supervisor

values.summary: Delete receipt choreography, make direct config validation authoritative, simplify Guardian launch, implement atomic reload, prove behavior, deploy, and publish.

steps.action: Map and remove the prepared receipt handshake while preserving real security boundaries.
Implement direct Kernel validation/hash readiness and one-child Guardian supervision.
Implement atomic candidate validation and reload/rollback.
Run focused and live regression proof for retained Runtime behavior.
Complete independent review and typed publication.

invariants: Only one Guardian child owns Runtime listeners
Failed reload preserves prior working state
Actual security boundaries remain fail closed
risks: Persisted service arguments may still reference retired receipt files
Reload crash recovery may select stale backup
Over-broad removal could weaken executable ownership checks
stop_conditions: Simplification requires weakening API, ACIP, identity, replay, or audit security
A competing Runtime owns the listener
Existing persisted config cannot be migrated without operator choice
Review finds unresolved P1 or P2 defects
